notes.title: Carton need you !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
Carton will be soon available for Linux and Mac !

[h1]However, i need some people to test the Mac version of Carton.[/h1]

The Linux 32 and 64 bit version works perfectly, only the Mac version of Carton has any display problems. To fix this last detail, i run this test :

[list]
 [*][b]This test is only for Mac user.[/b]
 [*][b]4 people can test the Mac version of Carton game during a few days.[/b]
 [*][b]Everyone can participate, you need just a Mac computer and send me a message at this email address : calepin.studio@mail.com[/b]
 [*][b]This mail need to contain your Mac version and your mail address to contact you with the instructions if you are selected.[/b]
[/list]

[i](Example : MAC OS X 10.8, Mountain Lion, 64 bit. addressmail@thing.stuff)[/i]

[b]At the end of this test, to thank those 4 people, They will receive a gift, one key of Carton game ! [/b]

I thank you all participants and wish you a good year 2017 !

[i](Minimal configuration : processor double core, 1 GB of memory, ATI or Nvidia 512 MB, 500 MB hard disk.)[/i]

notes.title: Carton UPDATE 1.0.12
notes.content:
[h1]This update adds some new features and many bugs fixes :[/h1]


- You can now change the difficulty of your party. More is difficult, less you have resource in the start and more the number of goblins is important. 

- Add a new loading window.

- Introduction movie size is more small

- Interface problem in the map menu is fixed.

- The cost of armor is more less.

- The cost of new character is more less.

- Add a new window in select mode to quickly see the resources of this tree, grass, stone …

- Information in English language is better translated.

- Fix the tutorial error in group and battle menu.

- Fix many collision bugs in the platform mod.

- Archer can't shoot through the wall and door.

- The warrior has a more bigger attack zone.

- Add some information in platform mod.
